description: Plan mode: the agent presents a plan with ExitPlanMode, which the user sends back with feedback; it presents another, which the user approves, switching the session to acceptEdits, and it makes the edit without asking.

command.text: Plan this change: in notes.txt, change the line apple to apricot. Read notes.txt, then present a short plan (two or three lines) with the ExitPlanMode tool. Once a plan is approved, make the change with the Edit tool and reply with just: done

resolution.message: Also change the line banana to blueberry.
